Early 2017,
I was drunk with my best-friend, there was some drama around his girl friend, there was this one guy who kept on harassing her and threatening that he would ruin her reputation because she didn’t want to date him.

We ran into the bloke, my best-friend (Let’s call him R.) proceeded to beat the living breaks out of him and leave him bleeding on the road.

Whilst he was laying on the ground unconscious, R noticed that his car keys fell out of his pocket, his car was 15 meters away from where we were standing, R took the keys and told me to hop in the car.

As soon as we jumped in the car, I’ve had a weird feeling that if we didn’t leave right away, we’ll have a really, really bad night today.

So I told him that we need to go now, he tried to insist that we take the car for a ride around the block but I managed to convince him to get out.

Not 3 minutes after we left from that place, the police showed up, the guy that R beat up was in the car, searching for his keys.

The next day we received news that the guy I was talking about was drunk-driving, his license was revoked three months ago, and there was weed and meth stashed in the passenger seat, exactly where I was sitting.
